name: Human Resources
description: Starter pack for HR and people operations: payroll cycles, onboarding, reviews, compliance and benefits.

definitions.title: Daily attendance and leave log check
definitions.note: Review attendance and leave requests and flag gaps.

definitions.title: Weekly new hire onboarding check
definitions.note: Check the onboarding checklist of every new starter this week.

definitions.title: Biweekly payroll processing
definitions.note: Process hours, wages, deductions and net pay.
steps: Send payslips and file remittance summaries

definitions.title: Monthly payroll remittance
definitions.note: Remit source deductions and employer portions on time.

definitions.title: Monthly probation review scan
definitions.note: List employees whose probation ends this month and book the review.

definitions.title: Quarterly performance review cycle prep
definitions.note: Prepare review forms and manager reminders for the cycle.

definitions.title: Quarterly benefits audit
definitions.note: Compare benefit enrolments against payroll and fix gaps.

definitions.title: Workplace policy review
definitions.note: Review the employee handbook and workplace policies with legal advice.

definitions.title: Employment agreement expiry scan
definitions.note: Scan fixed-term agreements and work permits expiring this year.

definitions.title: Employee handbook update
definitions.note: Update the handbook and collect signed acknowledgements.

definitions.title: Training plan preparation
definitions.note: Build next year's training plan from review outputs.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc employee relations case
definitions.note: Open and track an employee relations case - set the due date when creating it.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc job posting
definitions.note: Post a job opening and run the hiring pipeline.
